text: 10 OVERDOSAGE No specific antidotes for atorvastatin calcium are known. Contact Poison Control (1-800-222-1222) for latest recommendations. Due to extensive drug binding to plasma proteins, hemodialysis is not expected to significantly enhance atorvastatin calcium clearance.

10 OVERDOSAGE There is no specific treatment for atorvastatin calcium tablets overdosage. In the event of an overdose, the patient should be treated symptomatically, and supportive measures instituted as required. Due to extensive drug binding to plasma proteins, hemodialysis is not expected to significantly enhance atorvastatin calcium tablets clearance.
